summary: Align lifecycle email sending domain auth (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) + add deliverability monitoring for Growth sprint
description:
Background
- Growth is launching a 5-email onboarding sequence + retargeting during the lifecycle experiments sprint.
- Current deliverability metrics are trending down for Gmail (inbox placement + spam complaints). We also saw a small spike in “via sendgrid.net” display and some DMARC failures when recipients forward.
- We need to align SPF/DKIM for the actual From domain we’re using and ensure DMARC alignment is passing before ramping volume.

Request
1) Confirm current sending setup
- Provider: SendGrid (Marketing).
- From domain: redwoodinference.com (varies by campaign; typically hello@redwoodinference.com / updates@redwoodinference.com).
- Return-Path / bounce domain: currently SendGrid-managed (not aligned).

2) Update domain authentication settings
- Implement SendGrid Domain Authentication for a dedicated subdomain (preferred): updates.redwoodinference.com (open to mail.redwoodinference.com if that’s our standard).
- Ensure:
  - SPF includes SendGrid and is aligned (or at minimum passes; DMARC alignment via DKIM).
  - DKIM CNAME records added and verified.
  - DMARC policy present at _dmarc.redwoodinference.com (or confirm existing policy), with reporting enabled.
- Goal: DMARC pass rate >= 99% for authenticated volume, no “via sendgrid.net” in common clients.

3) Monitoring / dashboards
- Add/confirm monitoring for:
  - DMARC aggregate reports (daily) and failure reasons
  - Gmail Postmaster Tools: domain reputation + spam rate
  - SendGrid: bounce rate, blocks, spam reports, unsubscribes, invalid email rate
- Create a lightweight internal dashboard / alerting:
  - Alert if spam reports > 0.08% daily
  - Alert if bounce rate > 2% daily
  - Alert if DMARC pass rate < 98% daily

Constraints
- Avoid changing the primary corporate SPF record in a way that could affect other tooling.
- Keep DNS TTL reasonable (<= 3600) for cutover.
- Ensure we do not break suppression/unsubscribe handling (see SUP-2849 context; separate root cause, but deliverability work should not introduce regressions).

Acceptance criteria
- SendGrid shows “Authenticated” for the chosen subdomain.
- Gmail Postmaster Tools registered and reporting for the domain/subdomain.
- DMARC alignment verified (DKIM aligned) in at least 2 test sends to Gmail + Outlook.
- Dashboard + alert rules live and linked in #marketing and #support runbooks.

Owner / stakeholders
- Requestor: Tyler Benson (Marketing Ops)
- Partner: Ben Carter (Growth)
- Support: Allison Grant (Observability), Sean Gallagher (SLO/guardrails)

Notes
- If subdomain is new, confirm whether we want a separate DMARC record at _dmarc.updates.redwoodinference.com vs relying on org domain policy.
- We can keep DMARC policy at p=none initially if policy change risk is high; main goal is alignment + reporting before ramp.
